# Voicy

> Voicy (@voicybot) is an open-source Telegram bot that turns voice messages, round video notes, and audio or video files (27 extensions including .ogg, .opus, .flac, .wav, .mp3, .m4a and .mp4, up to 100 MB) into text. Audio files, videos and media documents stay off in a new chat until someone sends /files there. Send a voice message in a private chat, reply to one with @voicybot in Telegram Guest Mode, or add Voicy to a group, where it transcribes every incoming voice message by default (/transcribe_all switches to reply-only mode with /transcribe).

Speech recognition runs on Voicy's own GPUs with open-source Whisper (large-v3), which auto-detects roughly 100 spoken languages. Voicy is not free: each chat is activated once with a donation via /donate (from 300 Telegram Stars, $6.99 by card through Stripe, or tokens to borodutch.eth), while subscribers of @golden_borodutch get 50 free transcriptions per user first. The bot's menus speak English, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Russian and Ukrainian (/language changes the interface language). Voicy is MIT-licensed and made by Nikita Kolmogorov.

## Links
